title: Skin64Beta
description: Skin64Beta forces Beta 1.7.3 to natively render modern 64x64 double-layer player skins, adding real second-layer geometry (jacket, sleeves, pant legs) that otherwise don't exist in this version of the game.
body: Skin64Beta forces Beta 1.7.3 to natively render modern 64x64 double-layer player skins, adding real second-layer geometry (jacket, sleeves, pant legs) that doesn't otherwise exist in this version of the game. This mod will force the game to recognize 64x64 skins exclusively; any other dimensions will be defaulted back to the vanilla 64x32 Steve skin.
